_status: PROPOSED — NOT DEPLOYED. Live pipeline 9c7b26bd-11f3-432f-a7df-a30b56a8955f is unchanged.
_design: ZERO-EVIDENTIARY-COST filter set. Every rule targets telemetry that carries no security evidence, so nothing here weakens exfiltration, insider-threat, authentication or permission-change detection. SQLSecurityAuditEvents is left intact apart from paired-marker noise.
_why_deployable_now: Because no rule drops evidence, this set does NOT depend on verifying Azure-side audit retention (assessment point 5). It can go ahead while the routine-DML question (point 1) is still being resolved at governance level.
_excluded_deliberately: No routine-DML drop (proposed D3) and no successful-authentication drop (proposed D4). D3 destroys exfiltration/insider detection; D4 is a very poor bytes-per-value trade. Both are out of this set.
_governance: Decision Paper: Filtering of AZURE_SQL, 20/08/2026. Decision FILTER HEAVILY, Priority P2. NOTE: this set alone will NOT reach the 80% target - see AZURE_SQL_FILTER_DESIGN.md.
description: Azure SQL Log - zero-evidentiary-cost volume reduction (governance decision 20/08/2026)

processors._rule: R1 — non-security diagnostic / performance / health categories
processors._basis: GROUNDED. Keys on 'category', proven present in this feed (the live filter already matches it). Extends the live 6 categories to 11.
processors._cost: Zero. None of these categories carry authentication, permission, configuration or data-access evidence.
processors._note: 'Errors' is deliberately NOT included - it can carry investigation value (failed statements, injection attempts). Decision pending.

logConditions: body != nil and IsString(body) and IsMatch(body, "\"category\":\\s*\"(DatabaseWaitStatistics|QueryStoreWaitStatistics|QueryStoreRuntimeStatistics|ResourceUsageStats|Timeouts|AutomaticTuning|WorkflowRuntime|Blocks|Deadlocks|SQLInsights|DatabaseInstances)\"")

processors._basis: GROUNDED. Carried forward unchanged from the live filter.
processors._cost: Zero. The paired COMPLETED event carries the actual signal; STARTED is a marker only.

logConditions: body != nil and IsString(body) and IsMatch(body, "\"action_name\":\\s*\"BATCH STARTED\"")

processors._rule: R3 — Azure Monitor platform metrics records
processors._basis: Fingerprints the Azure metrics record shape (metricName + timeGrain). An audit event does not carry these fields, so false-positive risk is negligible. If no metrics reach this log type the rule simply never fires (fails safe).
processors._cost: Zero. Platform metrics carry no security evidence. Often a large, entirely overlooked volume contributor (a PT1M metrics stream was observed in this estate's feed list).

logConditions: body != nil and IsString(body) and IsMatch(body, "\"metricName\":") and IsMatch(body, "\"timeGrain\":\\s*\"PT")

processors._rule: R4 — OPTIONAL: session logout / connection teardown churn
processors._basis: CONFIRM the action_name value in this feed before enabling (candidates: LOGOUT, DATABASE AUTHENTICATION LOGOUT, CONNECTION CLOSED). If the value is wrong the rule simply never fires.
processors._cost: Near-zero, NOT zero. Logon events are retained in full - only teardown is dropped. Marginal loss of session-duration context. Remove this processor if you want a provably zero-cost set.
processors._important: This does NOT drop successful logons. LOGIN SUCCEEDED / DATABASE AUTHENTICATION SUCCEEDED and all FAILED events are retained.

logConditions: body != nil and IsString(body) and IsMatch(body, "\"action_name\":\\s*\"(LOGOUT|DATABASE AUTHENTICATION LOGOUT|CONNECTION CLOSED)\"")
